FoodDiary.ReadModel.Composition/Identity.reason: Read-only login-event and Users display projection with original filters, paging, search escaping and device summary date semantics.

FoodDiary.ReadModel.Composition/Ai/AiUsa.reason: Read-only usage aggregation and Users display join with original owner filtering and half-open date ranges.

Modules/Ai/Infrastructure/ModuleRegistra.reason: Registers scoped owner context for coordinated writes and separate typed options for independent quota/job transactions. The singleton prompt preview renderer uses only the request factory and adds no persistence access.

FoodDiary.ReadModel.Composition/Users/Us.reason: Host-composed scalar BodyMetrics read for Users goals; preserves owner filtering, date/creation ordering, nullable empty result and cancellation.
Host-composed scalar BodyMetrics read for Users goals; preserves owner filtering, date/creation ordering, nullable empty result and cancellation.

Modules/Users/Infrastructure/UsersModule.reason: Owner context saves before shared and dependent contexts using the declared AccountPrincipals priority. It registers owned sets, transaction synchronizers, Telegram conflict and account lifecycle write guards, and an owner purge participant for atomic receipts. Registration performs no queries or writes.

Modules/ContentReports/Infrastructure/Pe.reason: Owner context delegates saving to EF and translates only the public ContentReports UserId/TargetType/TargetId unique constraint into a concurrency conflict. No retry or independent commit; caller unit of work retains rollback ownership.

Modules/BodyMetrics/Infrastructure/Persi.reason: Owner context delegates saving to EF and translates only public WeightEntries and WaistEntries UserId/Date unique constraints into concurrency conflicts. No retry or independent save; the shared unit of work retains rollback ownership.

Modules/Users/Infrastructure/Persistence.reason: Owner-only no-tracking nutrition profile scalars and bounded goal pages. User/status/snapshot filters and stable limits remain; no aggregate loading or saves.

FoodDiary.ReadModel.Composition/MealPlan.reason: Bounded no-tracking public recipe selection and ID validation for owner catalog commands. Immutable scalar results only; MealPlanning owns mutations.

Modules/Users/Infrastructure/Persistence.reason: Owner save interceptor locks only the account principal for pending preferences/nutrition writes, checks persisted lifecycle and original security version, and holds the read lock until the coordinated transaction ends. No save, commit, retry, foreign write or credentials materialization.

Modules/Images/Infrastructure/Persistenc.reason: Reads exact owned object-key deletion IDs and passes only those IDs into the shared fenced outbox claim engine. No foreign queue message is claimed or processed.

Modules/Recipes/Infrastructure/Persisten.reason: Recipes owner locks all source-owned Recipe rows in ID order with SELECT FOR UPDATE in the Users-owned item transaction before authoritative reference selection. FK key-share checks serialize concurrent foreign links. Re-reads the owned closure, transfers legacy/gallery images through source-filtered Images ownership, then changes only selected own recipes. No foreign aggregate writes, save or commit. ADR 0054.

Modules/Products/Infrastructure/Persiste.reason: Products owner locks all source-owned Product rows in ID order with SELECT FOR UPDATE in the Users-owned item transaction before authoritative reference selection. FK key-share checks serialize concurrent foreign links. After recipe retention, re-reads surviving foreign references, transfers source-owned legacy/gallery assets through Images and changes only selected own products. No foreign aggregate writes, save or commit. ADR 0054.

Modules/Users/Infrastructure/Persistence.reason: Read-only preflight determines whether a successor is needed. Separate coordinated provisioning serializes the fixed infrastructure principal by advisory lock, validates non-auth state and stages the Users factory result. The coordinator saves and verifies COMMIT. The permanent empty principal can survive a later content-item rollback; content transfer and deletion remain atomic. ADR 0054.
